about: G7's allowed differences from reference.json. Each row names its row of docs/design/session-cycle.md section 2.5 and one difference, whole, as the G7 failure prints it. A row that matches nothing fails. Add rows only for a change that section 2.5 lists.

rows.why: Row 6: a quiet Effect joins the run dock's second line, in the room that is spare after Absent, with its word, then its icon, then not shown; no control of the line moves, and an act shows or hides only its words and its key letter (F2). The class is P4 in plain_evening.rs.
